description:
Title: Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine

You develop an application that helps you with the inspection of a machine.
After entering the type of the machine, and its serial number, the inspection can begin:
* Questions are asked, and you have to input values.
* Buttons are to be pressed, and values are automatically collected from the machine and shown to you.
* Depending on the results, additional questions are asked (or not).
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_MachineInspection" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/machine-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MachineInspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_InspectionStarted" name="Inspection started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToEnterData</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineData" name="Enter machine type and serial number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToEnterData</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterDataToAnswerQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerQuestions" name="Input answers to questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterDataToAnswerQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AnswerQuestionsToPressButton</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressButton" name="Press inspection button">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AnswerQuestionsToPressButton</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PressButtonToCollectValues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectMachineValues" name="Collect values from machine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PressButtonToCollectValues</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectValuesToShowValues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShowMachineValues" name="Show collected machine values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectValuesToShowValues</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShowValuesToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Split" name="Additional questions required?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShowValuesToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_YesAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" name="Input answers to additional questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_YesAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Join" name="Inspection checks merged">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted" name="Inspection completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToEnterData" sourceRef="StartEvent_InspectionStarted" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterDataToAnswerQuestions" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineData" targetRef="Task_AnswerQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AnswerQuestionsToPressButton" sourceRef="Task_AnswerQuestions" targetRef="Task_PressButton"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PressButtonToCollectValues" sourceRef="Task_PressButton" targetRef="Task_CollectMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectValuesToShowValues" sourceRef="Task_CollectMachineValues" targetRef="Task_ShowMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShowValuesToSplit" sourceRef="Task_ShowMachineValues" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_YesAdditionalQuestions" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Split" targetRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${additionalQuestionsRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Split" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalToJoin" sourceRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Join" targetRef="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
